# M6-S2 `&expr` and M6-S3 struct field defaults across modules.
# A loGo/s module gets field defaults through facts; a Go module
# importing the same loGo/s package gets zero values (documented hole).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Case 1: the loGo/s consumer gets defaults and fresh &expr variables.
cd lmod
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/luse$GOEXE ./use
exec $WORK/luse$GOEXE
stdout '^port=8080 host=localhost!$'
stdout '^42$'
cd ..

# Case 2: a Go package in another module gets zero values for the same literal.
cd gmod
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/guse$GOEXE ./gouse
exec $WORK/guse$GOEXE
stdout '^port=0 host=!$'
cd ..

# Case 3: the compiler archive carries the default records.
go tool compile -p example.com/lmod/cfg -o $WORK/cfg.a lmod/cfg/cfg.lgo
go run gmod/dumpfacts.go $WORK/cfg.a
stdout '^default Cfg Host 11$'
stdout '^default Cfg Port 4$'
stdout '^"localhost"$'
stdout '^8080$'

-- lmod/go.mod --
module example.com/lmod

go 1.27
-- lmod/cfg/cfg.lgo --
package cfg

type Cfg struct {
	Port int = 8080 `json:"port"`
	Host string = "localhost"
}
-- lmod/use/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lmod/cfg"
)

func main() {
	c := cfg.Cfg{}
	fmt.Printf("port=%d host=%s!\n", c.Port, c.Host)
	p := &42
	fmt.Println(*p)
}
-- gmod/go.mod --
module example.com/gmod

go 1.27

require example.com/lmod v0.0.0

replace example.com/lmod => ../lmod
-- gmod/gouse/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/lmod/cfg"
)

func main() {
	c := cfg.Cfg{}
	fmt.Printf("port=%d host=%s!\n", c.Port, c.Host)
}
-- gmod/dumpfacts.go --
// Command dumpfacts prints the __.LOGOS member of a compiler archive.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func fatal(err any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "dumpfacts: %v\n", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fatal("usage: dumpfacts archive")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(raw, []byte("!<arch>\n")) {
		fatal("not an archive")
	}
	off := len("!<arch>\n")
	for off+60 <= len(raw) {
		hdr := raw[off : off+60]
		if hdr[58] != '`' || hdr[59] != '\n' {
			fatal("corrupt header")
		}
		name := strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[:16]), " ")
		size, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[48:58]), " "), 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			fatal(err)
		}
		dataOff := off + 60
		if name == "__.LOGOS" {
			end := dataOff + int(size)
			if end > len(raw) {
				fatal("truncated member")
			}
			fmt.Printf("%s", raw[dataOff:end])
			return
		}
		off = dataOff + int(size) + int(size&1)
	}
	fatal("no __.LOGOS member")
}
